operations.description: Writes are transactional with audit and actor/scope-bound idempotency receipts. Reusing a key with a different body returns package_addon_conflict. assignment.create is the administrator's free allocation (never charges). assignment.purchase (549) charges the owner tenant's balance at the quoted price on the owner's behalf (the administrator is the recorded actor), creates a paid add-on order, and adds to an existing assignment of the same add-on; a changed price returns package_addon_price_changed, an insufficient available balance returns insufficient_funds (422). Product deletion and assignment deletion retain history. WAF is fixed to one allocation and deletion is rejected while bound policies use it.
